entries.basis: Confirmed from the volume itself, supplied by the researcher on 2026-09-05 and held privately by content hash: the cover and imprint read 'magical and religious literature of late antiquity 8', ISSN 2211-016X volume 8, ISBN 978-90-04-37700-4, series editors Shaked and Bhayro. MRLA 8 is Ford and Morgenstern, Aramaic Incantation Bowls in Museum Collections vol. 1 (Hilprecht). Supersedes IBI-PUBREG-17, which left this unresolved because the series number had not been checked.
